item: Every CI test leg keeps its junit report as an artifact; the shard timings of the merged run are recorded (C10 follow-up, R433)
summary: Each leg of the test and Core-only CI jobs uploads its junit.xml (artifact junit-test-shard-N, junit-core-only-shard-N, 14 days, on red runs too, never red itself, before the skip summary which stays the last step), so the cost table is refreshed from the three reports of any green run and no longer needs the 80-minute parity jobs back; tests/test_ci_shards.py pins the step with 13 mutants. CI_SHARDS.md and the C10 shipped-log entry now give the three measured runs, the step times of the last one (pytest steps within 3 percent of the table, the static steps of leg 1 about 100 s against 80 modelled, Core-only legs 1556/1122/1492 s) and the runner queue of 10:00 and 6:38 that made the required test check green at +40:04. Decided: a measured overhead is dropped, a Core-only table of its own and four shards are held (R433).
